canonical_statement: Classical Fountain theorem, specialized to a separable real Hilbert space presented by an orthonormal total sequence: an even C1 functional satisfying global Palais-Smale and Fountain geometry has critical points whose values tend to positive infinity.
domain_and_universes: universe u; complete real inner-product space E : Type u; e : Nat -> E; Phi : E -> Real; Prop in Lean universe 0
hypotheses: e is orthonormal and closure(span(range e)) = top
Phi is ContDiff Real 1 and even
there are 0 < r_k < rho_k, tail lower bounds b_k tending to infinity, and Phi <= 0 on finite-core rho_k-spheres
conclusion: There is u : Nat -> E such that every u n is critical and Phi (u n) tends to +infinity.
selection_boundary: The sparse Stage0 phrase does not identify a publication-level formula. Intake selected the classical Bartsch-Willem variant; this statement makes it concrete as a Hilbert-space specialization. Banach/Schauder-basis, dual-fountain, Cerami, levelwise-PS, and PDE-corollary variants are excluded substitutions.
checked_statement_transport: Stage1Instances.THM_M_1272.tendsto_critical_values_unbounded checks that the selected sequence conclusion entails unbounded critical values.
degenerate_cases: The total orthonormal Nat-family rules out zero and finite-dimensional spaces. Strict positivity and r_k < rho_k are explicit. Points need not be declared pairwise distinct because values tending to infinity force infinitely many distinct critical values.
